name: DNS Lookup MCP: Bulk DNS, MX, SPF and DMARC
description: Bulk DNS lookup for a list of domains: A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, NS, TXT, SOA and CAA, with SPF and DMARC checks and the email provider, one row per domain. Hosted on Apify's MCP server; the tool is the pay-per-event Apify Actor publicrecords/dns-lookup. Sign in with your own Apify account (OAuth or API token).
author: publicrecords
